decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - 1) The proposal through the number of units proposed results in an over development of the site, with a poor internal layout that provides unsatisfactory accommodation, specifically within units 4 + 5. This is contrary to policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.3.4 (Subdivision of Houses into Flats) and T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking) of the Adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003.

2) The conversion of an existing single family house to form six flats would be harmful to neighbours' living conditions, through increased noise and disturbance. Contrary to Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations), and H.3.4 (Conversion of Houses to Flats) of the adopted London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.

3) The proposal provides insufficient on-site parking, contrary to Council car parking standards, which would generate additional on street parking harmful to the free flow and safety of traffic and pedestrians on the adjoining highway and Red Route.
description: Retention of conversion of 6 x self contained flats.
